ctx.x: You remember when -- well, you wouldn't know, but when I was very young, there was a great critic by the name of James Gibbons Huneker and he wrote all kinds of fantastic books. He wrote a novel about Mary Garden called The Painted Veil, I think, and he wrote about some beautiful things about Caruso and he wrote beautiful stories about Chopin and just a great theatre critic and I remember a line when he first heard ragtime and he said, 'I don't think anything's going to come of this.'
